g.text: GPU work per step · place_container_plate / clean · 14 jobs per GPU

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #79696b

g.text: Required = head frame 91.9 + wrist frames at chunk start 4.7 + inference 1.8 ms (amortized per step); the run reached 96%

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #79696b

g.text: of it. A 5× pace on this task (462 ms per official step ÷ 5) is shorter than the head frame alone. Frames from several

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #79696b

g.text: processes or threads do not overlap on the GPU; H20 has no RT cores, and the frame time scales with the 32 samples per

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #79696b
font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #292122
font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #79696b

g.text: Only fewer frames per step goes further. The optional deferred-video mode (not the default) skips the head frame during

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #79696b

g.text: evaluation and rebuilds the videos afterwards: about 13–18× to scores (estimate); scores matched on 84 + 25 jobs, rebuilt
